pages.text: PROBLEM 2-6 Make three-dimensional drawings of the following molecules, and predict whether each has a dipole moment. If you expect a dipole moment, show its direction. (a) H2C CH2 (b) CHCl3 (c) CH2Cl2 (d) H2C CCl2
